write, run, and submit solutions from inside notes with a China-site account

disambiguation: Works only with the China site leetcode.cn, with a Chinese interface and generated learning content.
extras: LeetCode cookies and AI API keys are stored in plain text in data.json and must not be shared; AWS Bedrock credential flows read files outside the vault. AI provider fees may apply. Install is manual via GitHub Releases; community-plugin listing status is not guaranteed. Not affiliated with the original plugin, LeetCode, or Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to browse, run, or submit coding problems from LeetCode's China site or keep their study notes linked in the vault.
